title: Kalshi plans to require users seeking to make bets in some markets linked to material nonpublic information to submit an online form disclosing where they work (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Kalshi plans to require users seeking to make bets in some markets linked to material nonpublic information to submit an online form disclosing where they work — The popular predictions market is putting new guardrails in place for certain bets as concerns about suspicious activity rise
